string.text: Holographic sight made by an American company EOTech. Designed for close to mid-range engagements. XPS3-0 is quite compact, therefore is popular among stalkers. Attached to rifles with a Picatinny rail.
"Tubed" red dot sight made by a Swedish company Aimpoint AB. Used for medium and long range precision fire. Aiming reticle is a dot. Attached to rifles with a Picatinny rail.
Elcan Specter DR 1x/4x Assault optical sight

Optical scope made by a Canadian company ELCAN Optical Technologies with variable 1x/4x magnification. The reticle can be lit up with adjustable brightness. Has backup iron sights in case of failure of the optical part. Attached to rifles with a Picatinny rail.
Portable night scope made by a Russian company NPZ (Novosibirsk instrument-making plant) with fixed 3x magnification. Attached to rifles with a Picatinny rail.
